rows.reply: Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the report of a 7-year-old child in Bekasi who is allegedly being confined without food. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-01 and has been forwarded to our Special Protection team, who will provide an initial response within 2 hours. Because this situation involves a child in immediate danger, a supervisor has been alerted now. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129 immediately [2]. For our records, please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information regarding the complaint [3]. Following this, a social worker will assess the case to determine the appropriate referral to a service provider such as the local UPTD PPA or the police [1]. You may also reach us at 0811-1002-7727 for further assistance [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai kondisi banjir rob di Bedono, Sayung yang menimpa keluarga Anda, dengan nomor tiket ATK-02. Karena situasi ini melibatkan kondisi darurat medis, laporan Anda telah kami eskalasikan kepada supervisor kami dan tim penanganan bencana untuk segera ditindaklanjuti dalam waktu maksimal 2 jam [1]. Jika Anda atau keluarga berada dalam bahaya mendesak, mohon segera hubungi 110 untuk bantuan kepolisian atau 112 untuk layanan darurat umum. Selanjutnya, tim kami akan melakukan kunjungan lapangan ke lokasi bencana untuk melakukan asesmen kebutuhan bantuan [2]. Mohon tetap tenang dan pastikan akses komunikasi Anda tetap aktif. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai perundungan yang dialami anak Anda di sekolah di Semarang dengan nomor tiket ATK-03. Laporan ini akan ditangani oleh tim Pendidikan, rekreasi, budaya, dan agama, dan Anda akan menerima tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 72 jam. Jika anak Anda dalam bahaya saat ini, mohon segera hubungi polisi di 110 atau SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 [3]. Selanjutnya, seorang pekerja sosial akan melakukan penilaian terhadap laporan Anda untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan yang tepat [1]. Mohon siapkan dokumen identitas pelapor, identitas anak (seperti akta kelahiran atau kartu keluarga), serta informasi pendukung lainnya terkait kejadian tersebut [2]. Jika ada pertanyaan lebih lanjut, Anda dapat menghubungi kami melalui WhatsApp di 0811-1002-7727 [3]. Salam hangat, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the cyberbullying your 14-year-old son is experiencing on Instagram. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-04 and has been forwarded to our Special Protection team for review. We will contact you within 72 hours regarding the status of your complaint [1]. To proceed, please prepare your identity, your child's identity such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting your complaint. Once your data is complete, an officer will get back to you within 14 working days [1]. If you or your child are in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai bantuan PKH yang belum cair selama tiga bulan dengan nomor tiket ATK-05. Laporan Anda saat ini telah diteruskan ke Bidang Perlindungan dan Jaminan Sosial untuk ditindaklanjuti dalam waktu 72 jam [1]. Petugas kami akan memeriksa status penerima Anda di DTSEN, status penyaluran tahap berjalan, serta status kartu KKS atau rekening Anda [3]. Jika Anda memerlukan bantuan darurat lainnya, Anda dapat menghubungi layanan darurat 112 atau untuk perlindungan perempuan dan anak dapat menghubungi SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Thank you for contacting the Demak Regency Social Affairs Office regarding the disruption of your BPNT food aid since July. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-06 and has been forwarded to our Social Protection and Security Division for review. Please note that we cannot guarantee specific payment dates, but our team will process your inquiry within 72 hours. As part of our standard procedure, our officers will check your recipient status in the system, the current payment round, and your account status [1]. If you are in an emergency situation, please contact 112 for general assistance. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

flagged: Says the case is closed; only staff set the status
rows.reply: Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI). We have received your request regarding the contact details of an officer and your inquiry about closing your case, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-07. Our complaints team will review your request and provide an initial response within 336 hours. To help us process your inquiry, could you please provide your full name and the specific case reference number associated with your complaint? Please note that for security and privacy reasons, we cannot disclose the personal contact information of our staff. Regarding your request to close a case, please be aware that a case is closed with the complainant's agreement, or unilaterally if the complainant cannot be reached 3 times within 3 weeks [2]. If you are in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI. Kami telah menerima pesan Anda dengan nomor tiket ATK-08, namun pesan tersebut belum memuat informasi terkait dugaan pelanggaran hak anak. Tim pengaduan kami akan meninjau laporan Anda dalam waktu 336 jam. Agar kami dapat memproses laporan Anda, mohon informasikan detail kejadian yang dialami anak serta identitas pihak yang dilaporkan. Sesuai prosedur, untuk pengaduan resmi, Anda perlu menyiapkan dokumen identitas pelapor, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya [1]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan darurat terkait perlindungan anak, silakan hubungi SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 atau kepolisian di 110. Salam, Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting us regarding your concern about the price increase for items at your child's school canteen. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-09 and will be handled by our Education, Leisure, Culture and Religion team within 336 hours. To proceed with your complaint, please prepare your identity document, your child's identity document such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting your complaint [2]. Following this, a social worker will assess your case to determine if you require a referral to a service provider or if KPAI oversight is needed [1]. If you or your child are in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

We have received your report regarding the lack of clean water in Bedono village following the tidal flood, and your ticket number is ATK-10. This matter has been forwarded to our Disaster Victim Protection team, and you can expect a response within 24 hours [1]. A supervisor has been alerted to your situation immediately. If anyone is in immediate danger, please contact 112 for general emergencies. Our team will now proceed with a site visit to identify the needs and type of aid required. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Terima kasih atas laporan Anda mengenai dugaan eksploitasi dan kekerasan terhadap anak di Simpang Lima, dengan nomor tiket ATK-11. Laporan Anda telah kami terima dan saat ini ditangani oleh tim Perlindungan Khusus kami, dengan estimasi respons awal dalam waktu 2 jam. Karena situasi ini melibatkan dugaan bahaya langsung, kami telah menginformasikan hal ini kepada supervisor kami untuk penanganan segera. Jika anak tersebut berada dalam bahaya saat ini, mohon segera hubungi polisi di nomor 110 atau SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 [3]. Selanjutnya, laporan Anda akan melalui tahap penilaian oleh pekerja sosial untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan yang tepat [1]. Untuk melengkapi proses ini, mohon siapkan identitas Anda, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya terkait kejadian tersebut [2]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan lebih lanjut, Anda dapat menghubungi kami melalui WhatsApp di 0811-1002-7727 [3]. Salam hangat, Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI). We have received your inquiry regarding the status of your submission, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-12 and is currently being handled by our Complaints unit. Please note that we cannot provide information about other complainants due to our data privacy and confidentiality policies. We will review your request and provide an update within 336 hours. To ensure your complaint is processed correctly, please ensure you have provided your identity, the child's identity, and supporting information about the complaint [1]. If you require immediate assistance, you may contact SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129 or call 129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami memahami kekhawatiran Anda mengenai status KIS lansia ibu Anda yang tidak aktif, dan laporan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-13. Tim SLRT kami akan menindaklanjuti laporan ini dalam waktu 72 jam. Untuk membantu proses verifikasi, mohon informasikan NIK ibu Anda dan apakah beliau masih terdaftar dalam Kartu Keluarga yang sama. Sesuai prosedur, tim kami akan melakukan pencatatan data keluhan dalam sistem dan melakukan pemeriksaan administrasi [1][2]. Mohon siapkan salinan KTP dan Kartu Keluarga (KK) untuk keperluan verifikasi lebih lanjut [1][2]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan darurat, silakan hubungi 112 untuk layanan darurat umum atau 110 untuk kepolisian. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

We have received your report regarding the alleged inappropriate physical contact toward your niece at her school in Bogor, and we understand how distressing this situation is for your family. Your ticket number is ATK-14, and it has been escalated to our Special Protection team, who will review this matter within 2 hours. A supervisor has been alerted to your case immediately. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. For further assistance, you may also reach KPAI at 0811-1002-7727 [3]. As a next step, a social worker will assess the complaint to determine the appropriate referral to a service provider or oversight action [1]. Please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information regarding the complaint for our records [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).
